units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 3:6">Kel. III, 6</cite> <he>אינה ח׳</he> is not considered a connection (touching the stopper by an unclean person &c. does not affect the contents of the cask).

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 56b:3">Ab. Zar. 56ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>נצוק ח׳</he> the jet produced by pouring out is a connection (the liquid at one end, if touched by a gentile &c., affects that in the vessel); <cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 8:9">Toh. VIII, 9</cite>; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 8:4:2">Y. Sot. VIII, 22ᵈ</cite> <he>אין … ח׳ לעיר</he> we do not consider it as connected with the town (as regards Sabbath limits).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:6:3">Y. Kil. IX, end, 32ᵈ</cite> <he>ח׳ לבגד</he> considered as connected (woven) with the garment; a. fr.
